name: Zheng Chen
title: Bill D. Cook Associate Professor; Bio-inspired Robotics and Controls Lab Director
researchAreas: Learned visual feedback for underwater robots
fitReason: Applied physical AI through learned perception in actual underwater robot control and learned inspection; narrower subsea systems focus than general-purpose robot learning.

physicalEvidence.summary: The February 28, 2026 BSEE final report names Chen as PI and reports BlueROV2 with a modified Newton Subsea Gripper. Trained YOLOv8 flange detection and Hough pipeline orientation feed three-stage PID alignment, centering and approach, followed by actual autonomous flange grasping; an example converges near 30 s. Separate PZT-gripper experiments support learned bolt-condition classification. PINN-enhanced localization comparisons are explicitly simulation. This establishes an executed learned-perception/control stack, not just offline image accuracy; offshore pipeline deployment is not verified.

shortVisit.summary: The public lab opening is a funded PhD advertisement that can start as early as Spring 2018. Requiring a completed master’s for that PhD does not make it an external-master research-visit invitation. No current external short-visitor offer or summer 2027 capacity verified.

scoreReasons.fit: Substantive neural perception and learned inspection integrated into an applied robotic system; control itself is PID.
scoreReasons.physical: PI-directed report documents named ROV hardware, learned visual feedback and actual autonomous grasping, with simulation separated.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Old PhD advertisement is not an applicable external short-visit route.
scoreReasons.freshness: Dated February 2026 final technical report and current official associate-professor profile.
